university_name: Alma Mater Studiorum - Università di Bologna
deadline_text_verbatim: First selection (intake): from 10 February 2026 to 4 May 2026, 1:00 PM. Second selection (intake): from 5 May 2026 to 3 July 2026, 1:00 PM. Extraordinary selection (intake): from 3 September 2026 to 11 September 2026, 1:00 PM. Non-EU citizens residing abroad have 40 reserved places in the first intake.
limitations: Scoped specifically to the Economics and Finance bachelor's (Laurea) programme — Bologna, like most Italian universities, runs enrollment per-programme rather than one university-wide date; this row records the FIRST of three selection windows (the one non-EU applicants are specifically told to target for the 40 reserved places), not a university-wide deadline. Other bachelor's programmes at Bologna will have their own separate windows not captured in this pass.
